# Keen AI

> An Australian marketplace connecting small and medium businesses with
> vetted AI automation builders. Pre-launch — currently taking expressions
> of interest. Founded by Zak Levy.

## About

Keen AI is a small, Australian-first marketplace where businesses post AI
automation briefs and vetted builders pick them up. It is also a training
network: the builders on Keen are certified through a technical assessment
and category badges tied to real shipped work, and the marketplace itself
is how they keep levelling up.

Keen is currently pre-launch. At the moment the site is only gathering
expressions of interest on both sides so the founding round of briefs and
builders can be hand-matched before the platform opens publicly.

- **Website:** https://keenai.com.au
- **Email:** zak@keenai.com.au
- **Location:** Australia
- **Founded by:** Zak Levy
- **Status:** Pre-launch, taking expressions of interest
- **Positioning:** Marketplace for AI automation + builder training/certification

## Who it is for

- **Businesses:** Australian SMEs with things they would like to automate —
  chatbots, internal tooling, report generation, CRM hygiene, integrations,
  agents, back-office workflows, inbox triage, custom GPTs, and so on.
- **Builders:** People who build AI automations with tools like n8n, Zapier,
  custom GPTs, agentic frameworks, or bespoke code, and who want paid
  Australian work plus a network to keep learning in.

## How it works

1. **A brief gets posted** — a business describes what they want automated,
   the tools they already use, and their rough budget. Every brief has a
   budget attached before any builder sees it.
2. **A builder picks it up** — vetted builders propose a plan and a quote.
   Scope and price are agreed before any work starts.
3. **The thing gets built** — the builder ships, the business signs off,
   and payment is released. The business keeps the automation, the docs,
   and the credentials.

## Certification and training

- Every builder passes a technical assessment before taking paid briefs.
- Profiles carry category badges (n8n, agentic systems, custom GPTs,
  integrations, scrapers, etc.) tied to real delivered work.
- First builds are reviewed by senior builders in the network.
- Monthly training sessions cover frameworks and playbooks that are
  currently getting paid for, not last year's tutorials.

## Founding-builder terms

- First three paid builds are commission-free.
- Founding-builder badge stays on the profile.
- First look at new briefs in chosen categories.
- AUD payment, Australian timezone, no unpaid RFPs.

## Important note

Keen AI (keenai.com.au) is an Australian marketplace for AI automation and is
a separate entity from Keen AI Ltd (keen-ai.com), a UK-based company focused
on infrastructure and utilities AI. We are not affiliated.
